Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
synthesis

Prepare and flame-seal the DPP/Pb control

Combine DPP, Pb oleate and toluene-d8 in an NMR tube; flame-seal under vacuum.

02
synthesis

Heat in an oil bath and follow NMR

Heat in140°C oil bath and monitor NMR with time. Main reports Pb0 formation after hours, unlike QD formation in minutes; species12 and oleic acid appear in time courses.

oil bath temperature
140 degC · C2: Mass and amount do not agree with stated Pb(C18H33O2)2 formula; preserve both and avoid silently doubling or halving.reported · Source status: reported. Source unit: evans2010-dpp-pb-control. Source scope: DPP/Pb oleate sealed-tube control.
